## AniSequel

Find the anime sequels you finished the first season of and never got
around to, and add them to your AniList Planning list in one tap.

### 📦 APK package
**anisequel-universal.apk** runs on every supported device — there is
only one build, so there is nothing to choose between.

*Built from commit* `ea234a0881ba6806fdeeb6de5973e884335068a2` *on run* `71`.

### 🔑 First launch
AniSequel signs you in to your own AniList account through AniList's
OAuth page — there is no AniSequel account and no password to manage.

### ⚠️ Installing over an older build
Every release from this one onward is signed with the same key, so you
can install future updates over the top without uninstalling first.

If you are upgrading from **v1.0.16 or earlier**, or from any build
made between the first signing-key move and the 2026-10-05 key
rotation, the signing key has changed and Android will refuse the
install — a new key can never update an app signed with an old one.
Uninstall **AniSequel** once, then install this APK. This wipes the
app's local data, so expect to sign in to AniList again.

If Android reports **"App not installed as package conflicts"**, an
older copy sig
